attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Input1 is the exact original 65x67 card serving as the sole visual authority for pose, lighting, and crop; Input2 is the supplied mascot identity. Transform the human anatomy into a smooth golden-yellow compact round mascot head and body, featuring green-ringed black eyes and a simple closed mouth. Preserve the original short dark side hair and dark eyebrow hair, while retaining the distinct thin dark upper-lip moustache with a clean chin. Maintain the dark green uniform with open lapels, light grey shirt, and dark tie, ensuring source-visible gold collar and shoulder embroidery remains where not hidden by the note. Keep the dark green peaked cap with its small gold drop-like badge high on the crown, broad gold embroidered band, and dark visor. Do not add spectacles, beards, or unseen decorations. Construct a short broad chin-to-collar transition with a raised and refitted original collar and shoulder line, placing front cloth in front and rear behind, with a contact shadow. Avoid elongated yellow necks, funnels, clipping, floating collars, or cream bibs. Retain the whole dark tilted frame, opaque grey backing, and lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper short marks, preserving exact crop and occlusion. Ensure the entire backing, clothing, and subject are opaque, with genuine transparency only outside the complete card silhouette. Do not add readable text, figures, unseen awards, glasses, or unsupported cap details. Generate one asset without a comparison board.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: Nearly frontal stern bust with original mild head angle. Dark green peaked cap, small gold drop-like badge high on crown, broad GOLD embroidered band and dark visor. Visible short dark side hair and dark eyebrow HAIR, distinct thin dark UPPER-LIP MOUSTACHE with clean chin. Dark green uniform with OPEN lapels, light grey shirt and dark tie; source-visible gold collar/shoulder embroidery remains where not hidden by note. No spectacles or beard; do not add hidden larger-portrait decorations.
The mascot reference supplies body identity only and must not erase source hair, cap or clothes. Retain the source stern closed-mouth expression. No external label, watermark or new backdrop.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
attempts.rejection_reason: Actually viewed unchanged exact source, full returned original PNG, pair and white/cyan/alpha. Hair, eyebrow hair, thin upper-lip moustache with clean chin, cap/crown drop-shaped gold area and band/visor, green open uniform, grey shirt/tie, frame, opaque backing and note are retained. Reject the collar/anatomy fit: the lower yellow face/neck narrows into a long pointed V-shaped funnel extending down inside the narrow shirt opening, rather than a compact rounded chin meeting a short broad neckline. Refit/raise and broaden the existing shirt collar/shoulder line beneath a near-round mascot chin while preserving the original open jacket, shirt, tie and garment fastening. No garment-style switch, clipping, floating collar or cream bib. All internal surfaces remain opaque; exterior-only alpha is sound. Source tiny badge engraving is indistinct and is not a rejection reason. This defect requires a separate exact-fullsize builtin repair, not programmatic editing.
